objections.issue: With per-stream chains, the global order between two checkpoints is only proven at checkpoint granularity. An operator could reorder global positions across streams inside a checkpoint window without breaking any stream chain.
objections.proposal: Each event envelope also records the global position, and the checkpoint's Merkle leaves are (stream, head hash, head global position), so the cross-stream order is fixed at every checkpoint. Checkpoint frequency (every 1000 events or 5 minutes) bounds the remaining window.

signoff: Avery agrees: with A3 in place, no single person can quietly change what the record shows, and the catalogue gives me an attributable, policy-pinned, externally anchored ledger I can hand to a regulator.
